title: Vehicle catalog
description: The platform's makes and models, shared by every company.

help.title: About the vehicle catalog
help.overview: The vehicle catalog is the platform's: one list of vehicle types, their makes and the makes' models that every company shares, so the same car is never typed five different ways. Pick a car's model from it and the car gets its make, model and the model's specs.

sections.title: Each entry
items: A type (car, van, motorcycle…) holds makes; a make holds its models.
Can't find a make or model? Use Request an entry. The platform reviews it; until then only your company sees it.
A model's seats, doors, fuel and gearbox fill a car's specs when you pick it; you can still change them on the car.
Leave the end year empty while the model is still made. Order sorts entries on the same level, lowest first.
